set_fp16: enable or disable FP16 mixed precision training by calling set_fp16 with a boolean flag
delay_unscale: use the delay_unscale context manager to defer gradient unscaling during gradient accumulation
maybe_float: convert a HalfTensor to FloatTensor when FP16 is enabled using maybe_float
maybe_half: convert a FloatTensor to HalfTensor when FP16 is enabled using maybe_half
pad_length: pad a tensor length to the nearest multiple of 8 for tensor core optimization using pad_length
